_comment: In-game DPS parse from the MnSDummy training dummy, read off the Damage
Breakdown panel. This is the project's primary regression target: the
damage stack has never been validated against the game, and individual
combat-log lines are noisy in a way an averaged 58.5s parse is not.
Conditions, as reported by the player: all buffs maintained and used on
cooldown, spamming Magic Missile, weaving basic attacks to hold Brutalizer
stacks. Character is the level 100 Rogue/Hunter in pob_export.dat.
IMPORTANT: the exporter captured only one buff (FISH, a loot buff), so the
bundle describes this character UNBUFFED while these numbers are fully
buffed. Do not expect the planner to match this until buffs are modelled

fan_of_knives._note: Proc only - from the boots infusion ench_boots_proc_fan_of_knives_on_hit, 10% on hit. Never cast.

basic_attack._note: Weaved only to maintain Brutalizer stacks.

_comment: 415 hits over 53.9s is 7.70 impacts/sec, which is NOT the cast rate:
the game counts each projectile as a hit. 415 / 4.6162 projectile_count
= 89.9 casts, i.e. 1.67 casts/sec - which the planner's 1.54 already
gets within 8%. So `average_hit` below is PER PROJECTILE, not per cast.
This is the distinction that made the combat log misleading on its own.

planner_at_time_of_parse._comment: Where the planner stood when this was recorded, for tracking progress.
known_missing: effective rank 20 used instead of 23 (bonus ranks from gear ignored)
crit chance 71.5% predicted, parse shows 100% - crit is capped out in game
buffs not modelled at all: sharpen, hunters_focus, battle_orders, mirror_image
Brutalizer talent: up to +25% MORE physical at max stacks, held by weaving autos
Marauder talent: applies Shred, player runs 15-20 stacks on the target
